title: Optimize columnar vector top-k search
rationale: ColumnarVectorStore::search computed every distance and fully sorted all rows before returning the requested limit, despite the existing comment noting partial sort would be better. A top-k partition reduces sorting work for small limits while preserving returned result order.
steps: Use select_nth_unstable_by to keep only the nearest limit candidates
Sort only the retained top-k candidate window
Add unit coverage for ordering and zero-limit behavior
expected_impact: Reduces vector search sorting work from full result ordering to bounded top-k ordering when callers request small limits.
